    MagnitudeConjecture.CategoryTheory.linearExtAlong

    Linear Ext along a functor #

    For an R-linear abelian category C and a functor T : D ⥤ C, this file packages

    (X, d) ↦ Extⁿ(X, T(d))

    as a functor Cᵒᵖ ⥤ D ⥤ ModuleCat R. The derived-category Ext API already provides the groups and their two composition maps; the construction here only records their linear functoriality in a reusable, elaboration-light form.

    CategoryTheory.Functor D (ModuleCat R)

    For fixed first argument, degree, and T : D ⥤ C, Ext is a linear-module valued functor on D.
